description: For the user to download all the chosen sounds at once (other engines, or when they ask). Link to the .zip with the game's CHOSEN sounds and the manifest.json (neutral format for any engine): show it to the user, who opens it in any browser (it works for 24 hours). In Godot, the plugin installs it directly. An event with more than one sound (e.g. 3 sword hits) must be played by picking one of its files at random each time, never only the first: write the playback code that way and tell the user. Download tools: export_game gives the whole game as one .zip; get_manifest lists every chosen file with its project path (to save them one by one, or for a plugin); save_sound gives one single file.

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.
